description: Ask uetr.ai for a written Custom Monitor quote: a plan for more than 20 transfers at once, priced on request by monthly volume and check frequency, with webhooks, the REST API and MCP included. The quote goes by email to the address of the account that asks. We aim to reply by email within one business day with a written quote and a card payment link. An account can send 3 requests a day. Sending a request buys nothing and changes nothing in the account.

check_frequency.description: How often each transfer is checked: 5m (every 5 minutes, the standard), 1h, 12h (twice a day) or unsure.

monthly_transfers.description: How many transfers the account sends each month. There is no upper limit.

note.description: Anything else the quote should consider, such as the systems to connect.

name: request_custom_quote

reply_to.description: The email address the quote will be sent to.

title: Request a Custom Monitor quote
